text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I stopped by a sweets buffet with Bubble Gum Fellow,
Mayano Top Gun and Marvelous Sunday were also there.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Getting to meet Bubble is so maaaarvelouuus!
And having Trainer here makes it even more maaaarvelouuus!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that really feels marvelous!
What a coincidence to run into you in a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya invited Mave-chin!
They've got tons of mature sweets here!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Let's go grab some plates right away.
We might as well chat while we eat!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa!!
Bitter chocolate cake and coffee ice cream!
There's matcha mousse too! Pretty mature, huh?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It looks bitter, but it's maaarvelous☆
I made a castle out of cookies and baumkuchen★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~~!? That's so cool!
How does that work? Mave-chin, you're way too skilled!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I put the cake on a base lined with cookies.
If you flip the Baumkuchen over, it looks just like a bridge☆

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha! It's like a work of art.
Food presentation really shows someone's personality~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What about yours, Bubble-san? How does it—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh!!? What is this, it looks so mature!!
Cute! So stylish~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
An arc of strawberry sauce drawn on the plate, with mint garnish to top it off!
How simply maaaarvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Really? Heheh!
Actually, I based the plating on some sweets I had at a cafe before!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've seen this in a drama!
At that fancy restaurant where the stylish couple got engaged, they served desserts just like this!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
There was a message written in chocolate sauce on the plate,
and it totally made my heart flutter!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A message...! Ooh, I like that!
Maybe next time I'll borrow a bottle of chocolate sauce and try it?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make a garden in the castle
using colorful jam!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Kiwi jam for the grass,
with strawberry and grape jam flowers!
That'll make it suuuuper maaaarvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! At this point, it's practically a painting! Sounds great! I want to see it too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-san is totally getting into it~!
She didn't even say not to play with food!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, bad manners are a no-go, but
you want the presentation to look cute, right?
It's a sweets buffet, after all!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I want to pursue the "cute" that I love to the fullest, too!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
All right, I've decided!
Today, I'm gonna make the ultimate dish!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya too, Maya too!
I'm gonna make the ultimate grown-up presentation!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! Ah, how about this?
Let's have a contest to see who can
plate their dish the most beautifully!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That is sooo maaavelous!!
Let's do it! The marvelous possibilities are endless!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "I'm on it, I'm on it! Gotta eat this quick and move to the next one!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: *chomp*...! Ugh... so bitter.........

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I haven't touched my hot cocoa yet, so feel free to drink it!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was intense!
I'm stuffed...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow and the others couldn't stop coming up with ideas,
and since they ate everything they plated,
their stomachs were completely stuffed.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: “Still, thanks to Mayano and Marvelous, I was able to plate it perfectly too!”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Especially this one! Don't you think it looks pretty slick on me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The photo Bubble Gum Fellow showed me was a dish
with a square chocolate cake atop a cookie base,
signed with caramel sauce.
choice_data_list: It has a bittersweet, mature vibe that looks so cool!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I tried copying Mayano and added some chic colors!
Mine's milk chocolate, though...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Even just from presentation alone, I learned that there are so many possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell? I tried copying Marvelous
and made a cookie base!
That's why the back part is taller!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Even just from presentation alone, I learned that there are so many possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about running and winning races—you gotta think about how you look, too.
Otherwise, you can't captivate the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not satisfied with the status quo, aiming even higher.
I'm starting to look forward to seeing how she'll captivate
everyone around her from here on out!
